analyst_view.overall: Ferencvaros are 3rd with four wins from four, including 2-0 at AC Milan, and a win would all but secure a top-eight place; Celje are 25th with 4 points and fighting to stay in the play-off places. Balazs Borbely's side lost 3-1 at home to ETO on Saturday, ending a long unbeaten run, which he put down to unusual defensive and goalkeeping errors. Bamidele Yusuf is banned after his red card in Milan, for which he apologised publicly; the numbers already count it (about -17% on Ferencvaros's goals). Celje won 2-0 at home on Sunday with their usual starters and have no new absences beyond Pisek, who the numbers list. Italian referee Simone Sozza (about 4.1 cards a game) is in charge; news on both sides was thin and no full match preview was out yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals and already take a big slice off Ferencvaros for Yusuf's ban, with Lenny Joseph, who scored both goals in Milan, expected to lead the line. Saturday's loss to ETO showed some defensive wobbles, but Ferencvaros had conceded just 3 in their previous six, so nothing new points either way and I stay at 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, already up a little because Celje have conceded 43 in their last six. Ferencvaros should have most of the ball at home, which the split (5.4 to 3.9) already shows, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, already trimmed for both sides' calm recent card counts and set by referee Simone Sozza's average record (4.1 a game in 52 games). Yusuf's red in Milan was a one-off moment rather than a sign of a heated side, so I stay at 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.3 shots, with Celje's quieter recent shooting (49 in six) already taking 11% off their side. Celje's weekend win came with their usual starters, so no rotation is in sight, and I stay at 25.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target, already raised for Ferencvaros's sharp recent finishing (31 on target in six). With no new absences found beyond Yusuf's ban, which the numbers count, I stay at 9.6.
